reviews.text: Have used Maow Care a few times over the past year and have found them brilliant. It is peace of mind to go away and know that my cat is looked after. I only wish I had found them sooner. Alice and Emma have both looked after Jade (my cat) and she always looks well cared for and happy when I return! Will be going away more often now. :)

I am using Maow Care for years now. I am very happy with them. I am going on holidays knowing my cats are in good hands, even if one of them gets sick, which has happened, Maow Care took very good care of my cat when I was away. I really trust them and they are all very nice and really care about cats. I totally recommend Maow Care if you want the best care for your cats. 💗

We have been using Maowcare for a number of years now and Alice, Eva and the team have looked after our cats well whenever we were away. The client app is comprehensive and asks all the questions that you would want your cat sitter to know and have answers to. Our sitters always look after our cats well and keep me updated during our trips so I know they are doing ok. Highly recommend this service.

We have used Maowcare consistently over the past few years for holidays or shorter weekends away and we couldnt be happier with the service provided. Yvonne has been amazing and all the other cat sitters we had previously were all also very good. We receive pictures and videos of our cats daily while we are away and the cats love Yvonne as she plays with them and really spend 30 minutes of quality time with them. Alice is always very responsive and very understanding whenever i had to contact her to cancel requests at the last minute. I would absolutely recommend maowcare to anyone.

Maow Care is the best cat minding service. Extremely professional, I used Maow Care consistently for about 2 years while I was regularly travelling. The admin team is great but it was Andrea, in particular, who looked after our beloved Flakey and gave him such great care and attention that I could rest assured when I was away that he was in brilliant hands. This is a really special company with great ppl working who adore cats. I wouldn’t use anyone else.

I have been using Maow Care on the recommendation of a friend since I adopted my 2 cats nearly three years ago.
I will admit that I was a bit nervous the first time but Alice and Andrea (my sitter) were absolutely brilliant in reassuring me that everything would be fine. Andrea came for a pre-visit with me just to meet the cats so they would have some experience with her when she came officially and the website was incredibly detailed about the information required for the cats and all of the items that would be needed for their care.
While I was away I got videos and pictures for every visit which really helped me get over any anxiety I had about leaving them for an extended period of time.  The cats received excellent care and happily played with the sitter.

Since then I've used the service on multiple occassions and I have always received the same high level of service.  While I always hate being away from my cats for extended periods of time I am comforted in knowing that I'll be kept informed on how they are and that they are being given excellent care and attention.  Thank you Maow Care.

I've used Maow Care cat sitting services in the last few years and they have always been professional, reliable and trustworthy. The person who has looked after our cat each time is wonderful and I have no hesitation in recommending Maow Care based on my experience.

I've used Alice's cat sitting service for a few years now. I have a very nervous cat but his nervousness is always allowed for by the sitters. The photos and videos provided by the sitter each day I’m away give me wonderful peace of mind. This service allows my cat to stay in his home while I'm away which helps his stress. Wonderful service

We have been using Maow Care's services for our two cats for several years now, and would highly recommend them. Over the years they have given such care to our cats that we never worry about going away. The communication is always great, sending us pictures and videos so we know our fur babies are safe and happy. We have had a number of different sitters visit and every one has clearly been a huge cat fan and even our shyer cat always goes to them immediately. Their website means you can upload every last detail, from your cat's needs to alarm codes to the knack of opening that sticky back door. Absolutely recommend Alice and the team, they are always reliable and so caring.
